title: Assistant Professor of Economics - Lebanon Valley College - Annville, PA
description:
The Department of Business, Accounting, and Economics at Lebanon Valley College invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track Assistant Professor of Economics at our campus in Annville, Pennsylvania. This is an on-campus faculty position, with occasional telecommuting permitted when circumstances warrant (e.g., inclement weather or other emergencies). The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a regular on-campus presence to support in-person instruction, student engagement, academic advising, and meaningful participation in the life of the College.

Primary responsibilities include teaching a standard academic course load as assigned in the business and economics department, advising and mentoring students, supporting their academic progress and professional development, maintaining an active program of scholarly research and professional development, participating in departmental, college-wide, and community service activities, meeting faculty evaluation and performance expectations outlined in the Faculty Policies Manual, implementing and documenting departmental learning outcomes and assessment activities as assigned, contributing to the maintenance of program accreditation standards, documentation, and reporting requirements, support the College’s commitment to inclusion, belonging, collaboration, and the exchange of perspectives across differences. Conduct all duties and responsibilities in a safe manner in compliance with LVC policies and procedures. Perform all other duties and special projects assigned by the chair of the department. Multitask with success and meet deadlines. Work effectively in a team environment and independently. Handle a wide range of relationships and confidential situations. Utilize instructional technologies and software.

Must have Ph.D. (ABD) in Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, or a related field and 1 year relevant experience.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of required background checks.

Applicants should submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, statement of teaching philosophy, three confidential letters of recommendation and unofficial undergraduate and graduate transcripts (official transcripts will be required of candidates invited to interview).

Candidates should complete the on-line application process at lvc.edu/human-resources/employment/faculty-openings/
